How to use the Word Counter & Keyword Density

  1. Type or paste text into the box. All counts update live.
  2. Check reading time (238 words per minute) and speaking time (130 words per minute).
  3. Use the keyword table to spot overused words and check SEO keyword density.

Frequently asked questions

How are words counted?

Any run of letters, numbers, apostrophes or hyphens separated by spaces or punctuation counts as one word, matching how most word processors count.

How is reading time calculated?

Reading time assumes an average adult silent reading speed of 238 words per minute. Speaking time uses 130 words per minute, a typical presentation pace.

What is a good keyword density for SEO?

There is no magic number. Write naturally for readers; if a single keyword is well above 2–3% of your words, the text may read as repetitive.

Is my text saved or uploaded?

No. Everything is processed locally in your browser and disappears when you close the page.
